req.title: Register form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a registration form at GET /auth/register.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /auth/register must return an HTTP 2xx response with the registration form. We need: (1) a positive test confirming status 200 and form HTML content, (2) a negative test confirming that an unsupported method (POST with no data still renders the form, but a wrong path returns 404), and (3) a boundary test confirming the exact status code is 200 (not 201, not 199). We also assert on exact content markers present in the register template to catch mutations that swap templates or alter routing. Each test is self-contained with its own app/client/db setup.

tests.name: test_get_register_returns_200_with_form_html
preconditions: Flask app is created in TESTING mode with a temporary database
expected: Response body contains the register form HTML markers (e.g. 'Register' heading and input fields for username and password)
trace: R-FLASKR-002: system shall serve a registration form at GET /auth/register
EP: valid GET request to a valid endpoint is the nominal equivalence class
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_get_register_returns_200_with_form_html():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Register' in r.data
    assert b'username' in r.data
    assert b'password' in r.data
    assert b'<form' in r.data

test_get_register_returns_200_with_form_html()

actions: Send GET request to /auth/register with follow_redirects=False
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200 (no 301/302 redirect)

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_get_register_does_not_redirect():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == ''

test_get_register_does_not_redirect()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_get_register_form_action_and_method_attributes():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.data.lower()
    assert b'method="post"' in body or b"method='post'" in body
    assert b'name="username"' in body or b"name='username'" in body
    assert b'name="password"' in body or b"name='password'" in body
